whatIs.title: Betting?
whatIs.description: Positive EV (expected value) betting is a sports betting strategy that targets odds priced higher than a bet's true win probability. By comparing a sportsbook's price against a fair, no-vig line — often derived from sharp market odds — bettors can identify positions that pay out more than they should over the long run. A single positive EV bet can still lose; the edge shows up in the average return across many bets placed at a real, quantifiable advantage.

items.question: How does positive EV betting work?
items.answer: Positive EV betting compares a sportsbook's odds against a fair, no-vig reference price. When a sportsbook's odds imply a lower win probability than the fair line suggests, the bet is considered positive EV — priced to pay out more than the underlying risk justifies over time.

items.question: Is positive EV betting profitable?
items.answer: Positive EV opportunities can produce a favorable return when the required stake calculations and fair-value assumptions are correct. However, odds can change fast, and results vary bet to bet, so any single wager can still lose despite a real long-run edge.

items.question: Is positive EV betting legal?
items.answer: Positive EV betting is generally not prohibited as a betting strategy, though its legality depends on the gambling laws and licensed betting available in a bettor's jurisdiction. Regulations can differ between states, provinces, or territories.

items.question: Can Unbounded help me find positive EV opportunities?
items.answer: Yes, Unbounded helps you compare sportsbook odds against fair-value pricing, calculate expected value, and track the positions you bet on — all in one workflow.

items.question: How is Unbounded different from a +EV betting scanner?
items.answer: Unbounded goes beyond scanning for pricing gaps — it also helps you validate the opportunity with a built-in calculator, log the bets you place, and track your running results over time.
